Name: DE-TimeSheets
Description: Extracts the time entered in time sheets.
Statement:
with 
tap as
(
    select  Timesheet as TimesheetId,
            string_agg(convert(varchar(max), Name), ', ') as Approvers
    from    (
                select  distinct
                        tap.Timesheet,
                        apr.Name
                from    TimesheetApprover tap 
                            join UserLookup apr on apr.Id = tap.Approver
            ) t   
    group by Timesheet
)
select	tim.oid as TimesheetId,
        usl.Id as UserId,
        usl.Name as [User],
        ucm.Id as UserCompanyId,
        ucm.Name as UserCompany,
        dep.Id as UserDepartmentId,
        dep.Name as UserDepartment,
        usl.Mail as UserEmail,
        utg.Oid as TypologyId,
        utg.Name as Typology,
        tim.Date as Day,
        tim.DurationMinutes / 60.0 + tim.DurationHours as Hours,
        cli.Id as ClientId,
        cli.Name as Client,
        prj.Id as ProjectId,
        prj.Name as Project,
        prj.Number as ProjectNumber,
        job.Id as JobId,
        job.Name as Job,
        job.Number as JobNumber,
        typ.Name as JobType,
        iif(cli.Id is not null, tim.Billable, 0) as IsBillable,
        com.Id as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company,
        prd.Oid as ProductId,
        prd.Name as Product,
        prd.Code as ProductCode,
        prd.ExternalId as ProductExternalId,
        brd.Oid as BrandId,
        brd.Name as Brand,
        wrk.Oid as WorkTypeId,
        wrk.Name as WorkType,
        case
            when tim.RequestedApproval = 0 then 'Draft'
            when tim.RequestedApproval = 1 and tim.StateMachineTimesheetStatus = 0 then 'New'
            when tim.StateMachineTimesheetStatus = 1 then 'Approved'
            when tim.StateMachineTimesheetStatus = 2 then 'Rejected'
            when tim.StateMachineTimesheetStatus = 3 then 'Canceled'
        end as Status,
        isnull(apr.Name, tap.Approvers) as Approvers,
        apr.Id as ApproverId,
        apr.Name as Approver,
        apr.HasImage as ApproverHasImage,
        tim.ModifiedOn,
        tim.RequestedApproval,
        HourlyUserCost,
        TotalUserCost
from	Timesheet tim
            left join JobLookup job on job.Id = tim.Deliverable
            left join ProjectLookup prj on prj.Id = tim.Project or prj.Id = job.Project
            join UserLookup usl on usl.Id = tim.CreatedBy
            join CompanyLookup com on com.Id = tim.Company
            join CompanyLookup ucm on ucm.Id = usl.Company
            left join WorkType wrk on wrk.Oid = tim.WorkType
            left join ClientLookup cli on cli.Id = tim.Client
            left join CommercialClientProduct prd on prd.Oid = tim.Product
            left join Brand brd on brd.Oid = prd.Brand 
            join DepartmentLookup dep on dep.Id = tim.CreatedByDepartment
            join UserTypology utg on utg.Oid = usl.Typology
            left join JobType typ on typ.Oid = job.JobType
            left join tap on tap.TimesheetId = tim.Oid
            left join UserLookup apr on apr.Id = tim.Approver
